rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: ミネラル・リソーシズ

relations.text: 豪ウォジナのリチウム鉱山の合弁MARBLの相手(アルベマール60%で取得)
relations.text_en: Partner in the MARBL joint venture over the Wodgina lithium mine (Albemarle took 60%)

source.label: Albemarle 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On October 31, 2019, we completed the acquisition of a 60% interest in this hard rock lithium mine project and formed an unincorporated joint venture with MRL, named MARBL.

relations.text: アタカマ塩湖のリチウム採掘をSQMと同じくCORFOとのリース契約で行う
relations.text_en: Extracts Atacama lithium under a lease agreement with CORFO, as SQM does

source.label: SQM 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: SQM and Albemarle have a lease agreement with Corfo to extract and produce lithium from brines stored in the Salar de Atacama deposit.

relations.text: 10-Kでリチウム化合物の主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Named in its 10-K as a major lithium compounds competitor

source.label: Albemarle 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Major competitors in lithium compounds include Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile S.A., Sichuan Tianqi Lithium, Jiangxi Ganfeng Lithium, Rio Tinto plc, Pilbara Minerals, Tesla and a large number of additional Chinese companies.

relations.text: 10-Kでリチウム化合物の主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Named in its 10-K as a major lithium compounds competitor

source.label: Albemarle 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Major competitors in lithium compounds include Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile S.A., Sichuan Tianqi Lithium, Jiangxi Ganfeng Lithium, Rio Tinto plc, Pilbara Minerals, Tesla and a large number of additional Chinese companies.

relations.text: 10-Kでリチウム化合物の主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Named in its 10-K as a major lithium compounds competitor

source.label: Albemarle 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Major competitors in lithium compounds include Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile S.A., Sichuan Tianqi Lithium, Jiangxi Ganfeng Lithium, Rio Tinto plc, Pilbara Minerals, Tesla and a large number of additional Chinese companies.

relations.text: リチウムと臭素の両方で10-Kに挙がる競合
relations.text_en: Named in its 10-K as a competitor in both lithium and bromine

source.label: Albemarle 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Major competitors in lithium compounds include Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile S.A., Sichuan Tianqi Lithium, Jiangxi Ganfeng Lithium, Rio Tinto plc, Pilbara Minerals, Tesla and a large number of additional Chinese companies.

companies.name: ピルバラ・ミネラルズ

relations.text: 10-Kでリチウム化合物の主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Named in its 10-K as a major lithium compounds competitor

source.label: Albemarle 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Major competitors in lithium compounds include Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile S.A., Sichuan Tianqi Lithium, Jiangxi Ganfeng Lithium, Rio Tinto plc, Pilbara Minerals, Tesla and a large number of additional Chinese companies.

relations.text: 10-Kで臭素の最も重要な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Named in its 10-K as a most significant bromine competitor

source.label: Albemarle 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our most significant competitors are Lanxess AG, Israel Chemicals Ltd and Rio Tinto, as well as producers in India and China.

relations.text: 10-Kで臭素の最も重要な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Named in its 10-K as a most significant bromine competitor

source.label: Albemarle 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our most significant competitors are Lanxess AG, Israel Chemicals Ltd and Rio Tinto, as well as producers in India and China.

relations.text: ICL側も、臭素の2大競合の一社としてアルベマールを挙げる
relations.text_en: ICL in turn names Albemarle one of its two main bromine competitors

source.label: ICL 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: Based on internal estimates, in 2024 ICL and its two main competitors, Albemarle and Lanxess, accounted for the majority of worldwide production of bromine.

companies.name: アルカディウム・リチウム

relations.text: Arcadiumが10-Kで、高機能リチウム化合物の主な競合としてアルベマールを挙げる
relations.text_en: Arcadium names Albemarle a primary competitor in performance lithium compounds

source.label: Arcadium Lithium 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors for performance lithium compounds are Albemarle Corporation and Ganfeng Lithium.

relations.text: Ecovystが10-Kで、触媒分野の競合の一社としてアルベマールを挙げる
relations.text_en: Ecovyst names Albemarle among catalyst competitors

source.label: Ecovyst 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our Advanced Materials & Catalysts segment primarily competes with other global producers in the petrochemicals and refining industries such as Grace, BASF, UOP, and Albemarle

relations.text: Elevraが20-Fで、主要なリチウム生産者の競合の筆頭にアルベマールを挙げる
relations.text_en: Elevra lists Albemarle first among major lithium producers it competes with

source.label: Elevra Lithium 20-F(2025年6月期)
source.quote: Elevra competes against several major lithium producers, including: Albemarle Corporation, Sigma Lithium Corporation

relations.text: 天然痘治療薬の原薬製造をアルベマール時代から委託(現在はGrace)
relations.text_en: Has had API manufacturing agreements since 2011 with Albemarle's former unit, now Grace

source.label: SIGA Technologies 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: SIGA has had manufacturing agreements with Grace and a predecessor owner (Albemarle) since 2011.

relations.text: アルベマールは旧事業の一部で、訴訟費用の回収で和解契約がある
relations.text_en: Albemarle is a former operation of NewMarket, with a settlement agreement on cost recovery

source.label: NewMarket 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Certain of these costs are recoverable through the settlement agreements with The Travelers Indemnity Company and with Albemarle Corporation.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
